audit.why: 58.31% WR over 403 games; Pantheon favored at every stage (packet chart all-Pantheon, both layers agree). Difficulty is spacing discipline around Rebuttal, not any losing phase.
Spikes accurate: L2 W stun, L3 full kit, 6 Grand Starfall closes her spacing, first item lethal combo. Mel spikes on stacked Overwhelm + items but never flips the lane per data.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mel called he/his across 9 fields; cooldowns field had no numbers; dos/donts bleeds; Rebuttal's 38s rank-1 cooldown (the matchup's defining window) never stated.
audit.why: Rebuttal (W, 38/35/33/29/26s) reflects Pantheon's Q projectile back; his W dash-stun is point-and-click and goes through. Solar Snare (E, 11s) is her only peel and cancels Aegis channel positioning. Her passive Overwhelm is an execute — the missing-interaction on auto-reset tell folded into the donts edit.

edits.before: - Mel Rebuttal: matchup-defining — Reflects your projectiles back — never poke while it glows. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Aegis Assault like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1, 26s at max — it reflects your Q; never poke while it glows, and all-in the long gap after it drops. - Solar Snare cycles every 11s and is her only peel. - Guard your E (22s) like a fifth summoner spell.

edits.before: Mel is a fully immobile, squishy artillery-style mage, so the first two levels are about denying her free poke while respecting her Rebuttal reflect. Don't chuck long Q Comet Spears into her when the reflect is up — it turns your poke into her poke. Instead soak minor Radiant Volley ticks with your passive and last-hit cleanly. She has no escape, so every last-hit she takes near the wave is a step into your eventual W range.
